items.name: v0.16.0
items.body:
## What's Changed
* Make `tea issues create` honor `--output json` in [#1114](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1114)
* fix(pulls): report the real reason when a merge is refused in [#1107](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1107)
* Make `tea pulls create` honor `--output json` in [#1111](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1111)
* fix(deps): update module golang.org/x/crypto to v0.56.0 [security] in [#1109](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1109)
* fix(deps): update module golang.org/x/crypto to v0.55.0 [security] in [#1106](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1106)
* feat(login): add status command (#1087) in [#1105](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1105)
* fix(login): avoid panic when parsing auto-discovered SSH keys in [#1100](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1100)
* Read issue/PR description from stdin or a file in [#1096](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1096)
* fix(deps): update go toolchain directive to v1.26.6 [security] in [#1103](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1103)
* chore(deps): update docker/login-action digest to dbcb813 in [#1082](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1082)
* fix(oauth): don't wait for the browser opener to exit in [#1093](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1093)
* Drop AWS S3 release upload, keep only Cloudflare R2 in [#1092](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1092)
* chore: align go version handling with gitea in [#1088](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1088)

* @jamesbraid made their first contribution in [#1093](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1093)
* @silverwind made their first contribution in [#1088](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1088)

items.name: v0.15.0
items.body:
## What's Changed
* ci(goreleaser): mirror release artifacts to Cloudflare R2 in [#1063](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1063)
* fix(context): clarify the fallback login prompt wording in [#1061](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1061)
* Fix notifications --mine outside git repositories in [#1056](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1056)
* ci: wait for the gitea service to be ready before integration tests in [#1062](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1062)
* feat(assignees): add set, add, and remove assignees APIs in [#1045](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1045)
* fix(deps): update go dependencies in [#1057](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1057)
* fix(deps): update go dependencies in [#1051](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1051)
* fix(theme): don't query the terminal at start-up in [#1054](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1054)
* upgrade go sdk and add test in [#1048](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1048)
* feat(comments): accept -d/--description for comment body in [#1043](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1043)
* Add reply to code review in [#978](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/978)
* fix(http): add transport timeouts so tea fails fast on stalled servers in [#1020](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1020)
* fix(config): write to keychain before config in [#1044](https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/pulls/1044)
